description: This header defines a cross-platform ThreadLocal template class for thread-local storage, with special handling for Android's libgnustl issues. It includes macros for static thread-local variable declaration and supports both Android and non-Android environments.

classes.name: ThreadLocal
classes.description: A template class providing thread-local storage, with different implementations for Android (using pthreads) and other platforms.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a reference to the thread-local instance of the template type.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides pointer-like access to the thread-local instance.
